name: io.github.miketwalker/tubepull
title: TubePull
description: Download video/audio from YouTube, TikTok, Vimeo, SoundCloud, Mixcloud + 3 more. $3.99/mo.

tools.name: download_video
tools.title: Download video or audio (MP4 / MP3 / M4A)
tools.description:
Download a video or audio file from any supported platform: YouTube, TikTok, Vimeo, Dailymotion, Twitter/X, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, or Mixcloud. Output is MP4 (video, default) or MP3 / M4A (audio). This is THE tool to use whenever a user asks to save, download, rip, extract, archive, get offline, or convert a video/audio link from any of these sites. IMPORTANT: the `format` argument defaults to `mp4` (video). Only pass an audio format (mp3 / m4a / audio) when the user explicitly says audio, MP3, music, song, or "rip / extract the audio". Audio-only platforms (SoundCloud, Bandcamp, Mixcloud) always produce audio regardless of `format`.

Use this tool when the user says things like:
 - "download this video" / "download this TikTok" / "save this SoundCloud track"
 - "save that as MP3" / "rip the audio" / "extract the audio"
 - "get the song from this SoundCloud link" / "save this Mixcloud set"
 - "convert this YouTube video to MP4" / "download in 1080p"
 - "save this lecture/podcast/talk for offline"
 - "archive this clip" / "grab a copy of this video"
 - any sentence containing a youtube.com, youtu.be, tiktok.com, vimeo.com, dailymotion.com, twitter.com, x.com, soundcloud.com, bandcamp.com, or mixcloud.com URL plus a verb like download, save, rip, get, grab, fetch, pull, archive, convert, extract.

Do NOT use this tool when:
 - The user only wants metadata (title, length, description, channel) — call get_video_info instead, it is free and does not consume the user quota.
 - The link is a playlist / set / album / channel URL — ask the user for a single track/video.
 - The link is from a platform not in the supported list above (e.g. Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn).

Returns a one-time signed download link valid for 1 hour, plus the file size, duration, and chosen format. Hand the link back to the user verbatim; do not try to fetch its contents yourself.

Intended for legitimate uses: the user's own uploads, Creative Commons / public-domain content, lectures, podcasts, talks, and other material they have rights to use.

annotations.title: Download video or audio (MP4 / MP3 / M4A)

url.description: Full URL from any supported platform: youtube.com / youtu.be, tiktok.com, vimeo.com, dailymotion.com, twitter.com / x.com (status with video), soundcloud.com, bandcamp.com, or mixcloud.com. Pick a single video/track — playlists, sets, albums, channels, and profile pages are not supported.

format.description: Output format. DEFAULT IS `mp4` (video). Only choose an audio format when the user explicitly asks for audio, MP3, music, song, or "rip / extract the audio". `mp4` = video. `mp3` = MP3 audio (legacy-compatible). `m4a` = M4A audio (faster, smaller). `audio` = smart audio alias that resolves to M4A.

quality.description: Video quality. Ignored for audio formats. 1440p and 4k require an Unlimited subscription. Defaults to best.

download_url.description: One-time signed URL the user clicks to retrieve the file. Hand this to the user verbatim.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp after which the signed URL stops working (typically 1 hour from issue).

format.description: The format actually delivered (mp4, mp3, m4a).

duration_seconds.description: Duration of the source media in whole seconds.

title.description: Title of the source video or track.

tools.name: get_video_info
tools.title: Get video or audio metadata
tools.description:
Fetch metadata about a video or audio track WITHOUT downloading it. Works on every platform download_video supports: YouTube, TikTok, Vimeo, Dailymotion, Twitter/X, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, and Mixcloud. Returns title, uploader/channel name, duration, view count (when available), upload date, thumbnail URL, description, available video qualities, and (for YouTube) the license type.

Use this tool when the user says things like:
 - "what is this video about" / "summarize this video"
 - "how long is this track" / "when was this uploaded"
 - "who made this" / "what channel/artist is this from"
 - "is this Creative Commons" / "can I reuse this" / "what is the license"
 - "what qualities are available for this video"

Do NOT use this tool when:
 - The user wants to download, save, rip, extract, or convert the video/audio — use download_video for that.

Free to call — does not count against the user's download quota. Call this before download_video when you need to confirm the video exists, pick the right quality, or check licensing before downloading.

url.description: Full URL from any supported platform: youtube.com / youtu.be, tiktok.com, vimeo.com, dailymotion.com, twitter.com / x.com, soundcloud.com, bandcamp.com, or mixcloud.com.

channel.description: Uploader, channel, or artist name (platform-dependent label).

view_count.description: View / play count where the platform exposes it.

upload_date.description: ISO-8601 date the media was published.

thumbnail_url.description: URL of the highest-resolution thumbnail available.

available_qualities.description: List of selectable quality strings for download_video (e.g. ["360p","720p","1080p"]).

license.description: License label where exposed (YouTube only — "Standard YouTube License" or "Creative Commons").
